items.original_title: Northwell CEO Says Health Care Model Must Change
items.rss_summary: Northwell Health President and CEO Dr. John D’Angelo tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the traditional US health care model is unsustainable and that improving affordability will require a greater focus on wellness, prevention and chronic disease. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, D’Angelo discusses workforce shortages, the financial pressures facing nonprofit hospitals and how AI could reduce administrative burdens while preserving the human role in consequential medical decisions.

items.original_title: Freeland Warns US Alliances Are Fraying
items.rss_summary: Former Canadian Deputy Prime Minister Chrystia Freeland tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Canada and other democracies must become less reliant on the US while remaining open to rebuilding the Western alliance. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Freeland discusses Alberta’s separatist movement, President Donald Trump’s approach to Russia and Ukraine, and lessons from her negotiations with the US that inform her new book, Unreliable Boyfriend. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.original_title: Global Aid Cuts Deepen Humanitarian Strain
items.rss_summary: International Rescue Committee President and CEO David Miliband tells Bloomberg This Weekend that cuts in US and European aid are weakening the humanitarian response as conflicts and other crises intensify around the world. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Miliband discusses conditions in Ukraine, Yemen and Sudan, the challenge of containing disease outbreaks and the potential benefits and risks of AI in humanitarian work. (Source: Bloomberg)
